_comment: IDS Inference Engine + Alert Engine Configuration (Stacking Ensemble)
_meta_learner_threshold_notes: Decision boundary for the Logistic Regression meta-learner.
The meta-learner combines RF, XGBoost Binary, and ISO Forest outputs.
Meta-learner probability >= this threshold → classified as ATTACK.
_unknown_attack_iso_threshold_notes: ISO anomaly score at or above this → UNKNOWN_ATTACK (skip multiclass).
Isolation Forest alone determines novelty detection.
Higher values → fewer unknown classifications (more conservative).
_alert_min_severity_notes: Minimum severity level to generate an alert.
Set to MEDIUM to reduce noise on high-volume networks.
_alert_min_confidence_notes: Minimum attack_probability to generate an alert.
Flows with probability below this are suppressed even if attack=True.
_alert_suppressed_types_notes: Attack types to never alert on. Example: ["Bot"] to suppress Bot alerts.
Use only if you have verified the model is producing false positives for a type.
_alert_suppressed_ports_notes: Destination ports to never alert on. Example: [80, 443] to suppress web traffic alerts.
Use sparingly — suppressing ports hides legitimate attacks on those ports.
